workflows.name: Request Intake
workflows.description: Choose only when the request is vague, contradictory or undecided about what outcome is wanted, so it must be clarified first. Not when a concrete plan, change, or review is requested.

workflows.name: Plan Review
workflows.description: Choose whenever the request asks to write a plan, design architecture, or decide how to structure a feature (including its test and rollback plan) before coding. Not when a plan is already approved.

roles.planner: creates plan with tests and rollback

workflows.name: Implementation
workflows.description: Choose when the request is to make a concrete change (write code, fix a build, add tests, update docs, remove dead code) or re-run test suites. Not for writing a plan or reviewing existing code/SQL.

roles.verifier: re-runs tests and re-derives results independently

workflows.name: Security Review
workflows.description: Choose when the request is a hostile security audit of a change or area, or checks for secret leaks, auth flaws, untrusted input or injection. Not for general code style or database index reviews.

workflows.name: Merge Gate
workflows.description: Choose when the request asks whether finished work with passing reviews may merge into the branch. Not for re-running tests, reviewing code quality, or making changes.
